component.name: Tauridium
component.summary: Organize web services in persistent workspaces

description.p: Tauridium is a desktop client for organizing multiple web services in persistent, isolated webviews.

It supports local accountless use or Ferdium server synchronization, workspaces, bundled and custom recipes, per-service settings, portable exports, transactional backups, and a structured local audit log.

screenshot.caption: Tauridium sign-in and local accountless start screen

description.p: Fixes Linux release gates by validating native and Flatpak dialog backends in separate Cargo feature matrices.
Fixes strict Windows all-feature warnings and keeps generated capability schemas clean across release checks.
Fixes strict Windows Cargo checks by making the Flatpak zbus Tokio feature relationship explicit and lockfile-stable across target resolution.
Adds a dedicated Flatpak distribution mode, upstream desktop metadata, portal-first host integration, and Flathub packaging support.
